name: Group invite
description: Allows group managers to invite people into their group.
project_description:
The Group Invite module extends the Group module and allows group managers to invite people into their group.

 The invited user can choose whether to accept or decline the invitation. Upon acceptance, the user will receive group membership.

 This module is a continuation of the work done on this issue 

 How to enable Group Invitations 
 The Group Invite functionality can be added individually to group types. It has to be installed at the content plugin page at /admin/group/types/manage//content. 

 Please refer to the module guide for further instructions.

 Features 
 
 Send a single invite to a user (including a group role) 
 Sending multiple invites at once on a bulk operation (whithout role selection). 
 Handles both new and already registered users. 
 Customizable E-mail message for registered and new users 
 When accepting the invitation, the user will automatically receive a membership on the Group. 
 "My Invitations" page listing all of the current user's invitations to groups 
 Accept and decline actions for each invitation 
 
 Group invite 3.0 
 This version is based on Group 2.0, which provides upgrade path.

GroupContentEnabler plugin was replace with GroupRelationship plugin.

The rest of the module works as before.

Use this version, if you already using Group 1.0 and you want follow the upgrade path for Group module

 Group invite 4.0 
 This version is based on Group 3.0. In this version machine names are updated and it requires migration from ginvite 2.0 and ginvite 3.0. Use this version for new projects based on Group 3.0.
